methods.name: create
methods.summary: Creates a Keyless SSL configuration that allows SSL/TLS termination without exposing private keys to Cloudflare.
methods.description:
Creates a Keyless SSL configuration that allows SSL/TLS termination without
exposing private keys to Cloudflare. Keys remain on your infrastructure.

props.name: certificate
props.description: The zone's SSL certificate or SSL certificate and intermediate(s).

props.name: port
props.description:
The keyless SSL port used to communicate between Cloudflare and the
client's Keyless SSL server.

props.name: bundle_method
props.description:
A ubiquitous bundle has the highest probability of being verified
everywhere, even by clients using outdated or unusual trust stores. An optimal
bundle uses the shortest chain and newest intermediates. And the force bundle
verifies the chain, but does not otherwise modify it.

props.name: tunnel
private_ip
props.description: Private IP of the Key Server Host.
Configuration for using Keyless SSL through a Cloudflare Tunnel.

methods.name: list
methods.summary: List all Keyless SSL configurations for a given zone.
methods.description: List all Keyless SSL configurations for a given zone.

methods.name: delete
methods.description:
Removes a Keyless SSL configuration. SSL connections will no longer use the
keyless server for cryptographic operations.

methods.name: edit
methods.summary: This will update attributes of a Keyless SSL.
methods.description:
This will update attributes of a Keyless SSL. Consists of one or more of the
following: host,name,port.
